ModMetaData.name: AASB II - VPE Skipdoor Pathing Redux Compat
ModMetaData.author: JG
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility patch for As above, So below II and VPE Skipdoor Pathing Redux. Lets cross-level routes use skipdoors when Redux finds them cheaper than AASB's stair route, while retaining AASB stairs as fallback.
